text: System S5 is sound and complete with respect to the class of frames in which R is:
choices: an equivalence relation (reflexive, symmetric, and transitive)
explanation: S5 = K + T + 4 + 5 is characterized by equivalence-relation frames. Choice 1 (preorder) characterizes S4, not S5. Arbitrary relations give the base system K, and mere seriality gives KD (deontic).
